data.description: PLACEHOLDER (needs /dso:brainstorm). Source: 2026-06-08 FP-analysis of ~48 fp-recovery override PRs (~175 findings). ~28% of FPs (T1 type/symbol, T2 missing-file, T3 speculative-reachability) + much of T7 are assert-without-verify: the CI review-sub-pr reviewer (LiteLLM cross-provider router + hand-rolled raw tool-use loop) claims defects it never checked against the code. The orchestrator-side dso:code-reviewer-* agents (Claude Code agentic harness with Read/Grep/Bash) show far fewer such FPs — an in-house A/B. GOAL: give the CI reviewer a reliable agentic tool-loop + repo access (filesystem on the already-checked-out repo and/or GitHub MCP server) so it verifies before scoring. OPTIONS: (A) keep cross-provider — wrap LiteLLM with OpenAI Agents SDK (LitellmModel) or Pydantic AI (strong structured output) for loop+MCP; (B) commit to Claude — Claude Agent SDK (same harness as the orchestrator reviewers; native FS+MCP+read-only permission modes+structured findings+subagents; Claude-only but runs on Bedrock/Vertex/Azure). Decide based on whether 'cross-provider' means cloud/governance (Agent SDK OK) vs model diversity (keep LiteLLM+framework). ROLLOUT: shadow/advisory mode measured against the new FP ledger (epic 7412 task 7eff) before enforce cutover. Complements epic 7412 (reviewer-prompt VALID-patterns injection gives the instruction; this gives the capability to act on it).
data.title: Migrate CI reviewer from LiteLLM raw-loop to an agentic harness (MCP/filesystem repo access) to cut false positives
